design_policy.current_wave: Detailed design must be implementation-ready before the wave starts.
design_policy.next_wave: Maintain approximately one construction wave of detailed-design lead while the current wave is implemented.
design_policy.rationale: SDIB §19.2 step 23 permits M2 backlog refinement only after the M1 Exit Review is GO; therefore pre-GO work may capture interfaces, risks, ADR candidates and evidence needs, but must not freeze full M2 backlog/detail semantics.

waves.name: Cold-start & Exit
waves.design_ahead_for: M2 backlog refinement only after M1 Exit GO

m2_design_seed_allowed: record candidate interfaces that M2 sensor families will consume
record architecture risks and ADR questions exposed by M1
record evidence/test needs that would otherwise cause M1 rework
record dependency or schema pressure without changing Canonical authority
m2_not_allowed_before_m1_exit_go: freeze detailed M2 backlog as implementation authority
introduce RADAR/IRST/ESM/DL/FUS into the M1 vertical slice
change Canonical/Metric/Stage authority to satisfy speculative M2 design
